title: triocles
intro: Triocles, commonly known as Eclipta alba, is a flowering plant species in the daisy family that is native to North America and parts of Asia. This plant is valued for its numerous health benefits, including its ability to promote hair growth, reduce inflammation, and support liver function. The therapeutic actions of Triocles include its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and sesquiterpenes. Regular consumption of Triocles has been associated with improved overall health and well-being, making it a popular herb in traditional medicine.
